claim_boundary: No architecture, hourly model choice, CI/reference result, bounded learning campaign, trial-ledger result, internal regression decision, self-produced artifact, or unsigned/unverified independence assertion counts as verified AGI. A verified claim requires the conservative external production evidence gate to pass on genuinely independent auditable evidence with no unresolved failures or contamination.
